name: silent-storm
description: Operation Silent Storm - Historical media evidence inspection and review workbench
notes: Operation Silent Storm provides historical media inspection and review. Features include: release/chronology management, clip and frame inspection, media file serving, review and briefing workflows, delivery APIs, and contact sheet generation. Designed for analyzing historical open-source image/video archives.
